pdalgo_bypass.description: Whether to skip the PD algorithm

pdalgo_dump.description: Enter the pd raw switch of the algorithm library

dump_skip.description: Save the pd raw of the input algorithm library every number of frames

center_max_w_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scaling of the upper limit of the center area width relative to the image width

center_max_h_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the upper limit of the center region's height relative to the zoom ratio of the image's height

center_min_w_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scaling ratio of the lower limit of the center area width relative to the image width

center_min_h_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scaling ratio of the lower bound of the center region height relative to the image height

touch_max_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scale of the upper limit of the side length of the touch area relative to the short side of the image

touch_min_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scale of the lower limit of the side length of the touch area relative to the short side of the image

face_max_w_ratio.description: the value divided by 1000, represents the face area wide maximum relative to the image of wide scale. The default value is 250

face_max_h_ratio.description: the value divided by 1000, represents the face area high ceiling high relative to the image scaling

face_min_w_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scaling of the lower limit of the face area width relative to the image width

face_min_h_ratio.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the scaling ratio of the lower limit of the face area height relative to the image height

line_band_num.description: Number of adjacent left/right pd lines added

sadoffset_stride.description: The step size to find the minimum sad value in the process of calculating the phase difference

sadmap_th.description: The value /100000 represents the threshold correlation coefficient for judging the flat scene

pd_offset.description: This value, divided by 1000, represents the offset based on the original phase difference

saturated_pixel_thr.description: The brightness threshold of saturated pixels

saturated_bigarea_thr.description: The value /1000 represents the threshold of big area point light

saturated_smallarea_thr.description: The value /1000 represents the threshold of small area point light

saturated_lrnumdiff_thr.description: The value /1000 represents the threshold for the difference saturated pixels num between the left and right of small area point light

diffscene_enable.description: Enable switches with different thresholds for different scenes

center_bv_thr.description: Brightness threshold division for center scene

touch_bv_thr.description: Brightness threshold division for touch scene

face_bv_thr.description: Brightness threshold division for face scene

center_enable.description: Enable switch for center scene moire detection

touch_enable.description: Enable switch for touch scene moire detection

face_enable.description: Enable switch for face scene moire detection

photo_debuginfo_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating photo debuginfo memory

video_debuginfo_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating video debuginfo memory

multiwin_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating multiwin memory

interpolate_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating interpolate memory

spc_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating spc memory

dcc_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating dcc memory

lineband_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating lineband memory

cosin_sim_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating old conf_score memory

reorder_disable.description: Enable switch for allocating reorder memory

filter_enable.description: Enable switch for allocating filter memory

log_adjust_enable.description: Enable switch for adjusting log level

log_level.description: log level 2 for LOGV, log level 3 for LOGD
